caption:
Ring once and wait

The second figure says to keep pressing the bell. She rings once and waits, and the door opens on its own time.

Ringing again and again only makes the wait feel longer, and the door was already on its way.

For whoever rings once and lets the door take its time.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. The outside of a building with a closed cream door on the right and a small panel with an orange bell button beside it. Two block figures with white eyes stand on the left, one ink-black and one royal blue. The royal blue one says press it again. The ink-black one presses the button once, it lights up yellow, and then it waits. The royal blue one fidgets and says ten whole seconds. The door swings open onto warm light and both figures turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me ringing once and waiting.
